column2: three plain tall rectangular playing cards with rounded corners, spread like a fan in a hand of cards: the left card tilted left, the right card tilted right, the middle card upright in front; thin white cut lines separate the overlapping cards; the front card has one round seal cut out in its middle. They must read as playing cards, not as a flower or leaves
a curved Ottoman dagger (hançer) standing upright, point down, with a broad curved blade at least one sixth of the canvas wide at its widest, a round pommel and a short crossguard

a tall upright paper scroll (an imperial edict) with its top and bottom edges rolled into thick curls, one large looping tuğra-like cut-out shape in its upper half (abstract loops, no letters), and a round seal hanging from a short cord below the bottom curl
a masquerade eye mask with two almond-shaped eye holes and a short ribbon tie at each side, shown on its own, no face behind it
the same thick ring as Image 2, with a bold infinity sign (a figure-eight lying on its side) across its centre instead of the bar
the same thick ring proportions as Image 2, but the ring is one curved arrow that runs almost all the way around with a single arrowhead at its end, and a small round dot in the centre
an Ottoman mace (topuz): a round ribbed head on a short straight handle, standing upright
an Ottoman headstone (mezar taşı): a tall narrow upright slab on a low base, topped by a carved turban
an ornate Ottoman padlock with its curved shackle swung open
a staircase of four square blocks rising from lower left to upper right, each one step higher than the last, with a small round shield standing on the top block; the whole shape fills the square
a staircase of five square blocks rising from lower left to upper right, each one step higher than the last, with a small dagger standing point down on the top block; the whole shape fills the square
the same kallavi turban as Image 2, with a large round medallion overlapping its lower right; one upright bar is cut out of the medallion
the same kallavi turban as Image 2, with a large round medallion overlapping its lower right; two upright bars side by side are cut out of the medallion
an Ottoman palace gate seen from the front: one arched gateway between two slender towers with tall pointed conical roofs

a square Ottoman seal block with rounded corners, seen straight from the front, with a small ring-shaped loop handle on top; one eight-pointed star cut out of the middle of its face. No head, no shoulders, no figure
a folded letter seen from the front, its flap closed with a large round wax seal in the middle
a single almond-shaped watching eye with a large round pupil, its two corners ending in rumi split-leaf points
an ornate Ottoman key standing upright: a pierced round bow at the top, a long shaft and a bit at the bottom
